strategy: Enforce 5-phase state machine in server.js: Investigate -> Planning -> Implementation -> Documentation -> Closeout.

architecture.phase_advancement: POST /api/phase-advance moves the current phase forward sequentially only (Investigate -> Planning -> Implementation -> Documentation -> Closeout).

flicker_fix: Server returns stable currentTask data; do not recreate currentTask on every status poll, only when it actually changes to prevent UI flickering.
log_fix: Keep the last 50 log entries in state.logs persistently (do not drain on status poll) so the UI has a permanent history of recent activity.
dispatcher_fix: Server keeps the dispatcher status as active (dispatcher.idle = false) while the /aic session is active.

api_changes.GET /api/status: Returns the workflow object representing current phase and history.
